titles.romaji: Precure All Stars GoGo Dream Live!
titles.native: プリキュアオールスターズ GoGoドリームライブ!

description: A short special made to celebrate the Precure franchise's 5th anniversary, included in the Yes! Precure 5 GoGo! Okashi no Kuni no Happy Birthday movie. This marks the first time different Precure teams meet in animated media.
